<reason>PRO kept the motion as free-by-default optional floor vs paywalled best tools, while CON drifted to mandatory universal ID and unlimited concierge. PRO's working-lock and single-actor points were never neutralized: an evadable block is not safety, and payment friction misses the one unpaid harasser/scam profile. CON's live points on norm-coercion and triage cost hurt but cut partly against verification itself.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>B's Q1 working-lock pressure plus follow-through that billing for a ban that sticks prices the exit, exposing CON's basic vs enforcement split as the two-class system.</best_rebuttal>
